renderer: Scientific paths and sampled curves; MathJax 4.1.3 / resvg 2.6.2; 3x pixels

7019380f33af550e616fdd0bfd50e1ba816c430e.name: Ackley
7019380f33af550e616fdd0bfd50e1ba816c430e.caption: The two-coordinate landscape has a narrow central basin and repeated shallow basins around it. Coloured curves join equal objective values. The orange line is the y=0 cross-section shown on the right; the marked global minimum is at (0,0).
7019380f33af550e616fdd0bfd50e1ba816c430e.alt: Ackley in two coordinates, x and y from -4 to 4: nested and rippled contours surround the global minimum at (0,0). The y=0 slice has its deepest value zero at x=0, with smaller repeated local basins on either side.

f0146f5e4baf83ebc91bd63409b12b4c41b35336.name: Rastrigin
f0146f5e4baf83ebc91bd63409b12b4c41b35336.caption: The repeated contour islands are local basins inside the larger quadratic bowl. The y=0 slice shows the periodic barriers between them. Only the marked origin attains the global value zero; the nearby basins remain higher.
f0146f5e4baf83ebc91bd63409b12b4c41b35336.alt: Rastrigin in two coordinates from -3 to 3: a grid of local basins surrounds the unique global minimum at the origin. The y=0 slice oscillates above zero except at x=0.

e8ad7c27320129acd925a6c228050932ecc01977.name: Bohachevsky1
e8ad7c27320129acd925a6c228050932ecc01977.caption: This drawing follows the value returned by Bohachevsky1, whose minimum is -0.7 at the origin. Adding 0.7 produces the standard definition above: every height changes, while the contours and minimizing coordinates keep their shapes and positions.
e8ad7c27320129acd925a6c228050932ecc01977.alt: Bohachevsky1 as returned by the application, without the standard +0.7 offset: contours of an oscillatory bowl and its y=0 cross-section. The marked origin has value -0.7, not zero.

25bd575abe2e7259472d3b067959a5e6b7a16736.name: Himmelblau
25bd575abe2e7259472d3b067959a5e6b7a16736.caption: Four separate basins attain the same global value zero; all four minimizing points are marked. The y=2 slice passes through (3,2) but misses the other three minima. A one-dimensional slice alone cannot establish the number of minima of a surface.
25bd575abe2e7259472d3b067959a5e6b7a16736.alt: Himmelblau level curves show four distinct equal-depth basins. Four global minimizers are marked. The horizontal y=2 slice passes through the minimum (3,2), where both squared terms vanish.

f1e5eee6747b1889028720329f1ba1986203ba2d.name: Matyas
f1e5eee6747b1889028720329f1ba1986203ba2d.caption: The long contour ellipses follow the diagonal y=x: changing both coordinates together moves along the shallow valley. Along that orange diagonal the function reduces to 0.04x². Perpendicular to it, along y=-x, the curvature is much stronger.
f1e5eee6747b1889028720329f1ba1986203ba2d.alt: Matyas has long elliptical contours aligned with y=x and a unique minimum at the origin. The plotted diagonal slice is 0.04x squared, demonstrating the shallow direction of the valley.

f18f1d92d2bdb380b6ca5c7adceb8066a7bb0955.name: Rosenbrock
f18f1d92d2bdb380b6ca5c7adceb8066a7bb0955.caption: The orange path follows the curved valley y=x², rather than a straight cross-section. On this path the large squared penalty vanishes and only (1-x)² remains, reaching zero at the marked point (1,1). The close contour spacing across the valley shows why movement across it is costly.
f18f1d92d2bdb380b6ca5c7adceb8066a7bb0955.alt: Rosenbrock contours bend around the parabola y=x squared. The marked global minimum is (1,1). The right panel follows that curved path and plots (1-x) squared, with its minimum at x=1.

8d4b6810a30f1a68e77217329ec1b215d7b79f62.name: dropWave
8d4b6810a30f1a68e77217329ec1b215d7b79f62.caption: Concentric rings reflect the dependence on distance from the origin. The y=0 slice shows repeated negative troughs, with the deepest value -1 at the centre. The intervening peaks approach zero, which is not the minimizing value.
8d4b6810a30f1a68e77217329ec1b215d7b79f62.alt: Drop-wave has concentric oscillatory rings around the origin. Its y=0 slice repeatedly drops below zero and reaches its deepest trough, -1, at x=0.

c82d1735d932e3443389b65c7f780a723244c665.name: sixHumpCamel
c82d1735d932e3443389b65c7f780a723244c665.caption: Two symmetry-related global basins are marked. The horizontal slice uses the rounded y-coordinate of the lower basin and passes close to its minimum, near x=0.089842. Other closed contours correspond to higher basins; a stationary point need not be globally best.
c82d1735d932e3443389b65c7f780a723244c665.alt: Six-hump camel contours show two symmetry-related deepest basins near (0.089842,-0.712656) and (-0.089842,0.712656). The plotted lower horizontal slice reaches approximately -1.031628 near x=0.089842.

995a00705b77afaab3529b9ea2a3eec6ee524193.name: UnitCircle
995a00705b77afaab3529b9ea2a3eec6ee524193.caption: Real-angle illustration at θ=π/4 radians: the radius-one point is (cosθ,sinθ)=(√2/2,√2/2). The blue horizontal and orange vertical projections are signed x and y coordinates; the axes also show their negative directions. Complex inputs are not represented by this circle.
995a00705b77afaab3529b9ea2a3eec6ee524193.alt: Real-angle unit circle at θ=π/4: a radius of one reaches the point (√2/2,√2/2). Blue cosine and orange sine projections give its horizontal and vertical coordinates. Both axes include -1 and 1. Complex inputs are not represented by this circle.

d7b540322dcf6ee14bb26ce2f0ea0d35ca61edfb.name: StandardNormal
d7b540322dcf6ee14bb26ce2f0ea0d35ca61edfb.caption: Standard-normal example with μ=0 and σ=1. The shaded left-tail area for X≤1 has probability approximately 0.8413; the orange marker has density f(1)≈0.2420, a height rather than a probability. The drawing shows x from -4 to 4; both tails continue beyond the plotted range, and the stated probability includes the entire left tail.
d7b540322dcf6ee14bb26ce2f0ea0d35ca61edfb.alt: Standard-normal density with μ=0 and σ=1, shown from x=-4 to x=4. The region left of x=1 is shaded for cumulative probability approximately 0.8413. The marked curve height at x=1 is approximately 0.2420. Both tails continue beyond the drawing.
